post.summary:
A real input ping from the app (AC-22): passed to `/auth/session/activity`. The app sends
it at most once a minute; welinc-auth ignores more than 2 a minute per session.

get.summary:
The login comes back. The state cookie is checked and cleared before welinc-auth is
called, so a retried or prefetched callback fails as `LOGIN_STATE_INVALID` (AC-15).

post.summary:
Logout (AC-24, AC-42). Always clears `vrms_rt`. The session is ended by the cookie's token,
or by the access token's `sid` when the cookie's token matches nothing at welinc-auth. If
welinc-auth can't be reached it answers 503, so the app can offer a retry, which still
works through the access token's `sid`.

info.title: VRMS API
info.description:
The VRMS API: repair tickets, issues and checklists, vehicles, the knowledge base, attachments,
analytics, AI diagnosis and settings. Every API route takes a VRMS user access token; the
`/vrms/session` routes are the web app's login and refresh, with the `vrms_rt` cookie.

These docs are generated from the code and show the shapes of each route. Sign in and tokens
are welinc-auth's: see its docs at `/auth/docs` and
[contract 0001](https://github.com/Capstone-WeLinc/welinc-workspace/blob/main/docs/specs/_root/0001-shared-services-contract/index.md).

userToken.description: A VRMS user access token (`aud: VRMS`, `token_use: user`), from `/vrms/session/refresh`.

vrmsSession.name: vrms_rt
vrmsSession.description: The VRMS web session's refresh cookie (`__Secure-vrms_rt` when hosted), on `/vrms/session`.

message.description: A sentence for people; may change. Match on `code`, never on this.

code.description: The stable error code (contract 0001 section 11). Absent on a plain validation 400.
